Correction (11:45 11/05/2026): Under the PLaMo Community License, individuals and enterprises with an annual revenue of less than 1 billion Japanese yen or less in their most recent fiscal year can download and use the models free of charge. 

TOKYO, November 5, 2026 – Preferred Networks, Inc. (PFN) today announced the open-weight release of PLaMo™ 3 Translate*, a suite of translation-specialized large language models (LLMs). Originally developed for PFN’s PLaMo Translate service, the open-weight models are now publicly available on PFN’s Hugging Face page.

Under the PLaMo Community License, individuals and enterprises with an annual revenue of 1 billion Japanese yen or less in their most recent fiscal year can download and use the models free of charge. This applies to both commercial and non-commercial applications, allowing users to run the models entirely on edge devices such as smartphones, laptops, and internal corporate servers without requiring an internet connection.

PLaMo 3 Translate provides users with the underlying model weights necessary to run the AI natively on their own hardware. It is available in four sizes: 0.8B (0.8 billion parameters), 2B, 8B, and 31B. This tiered approach allows developers to select the ideal model based on their specific requirements for translation quality, latency, processing volume, and target hardware.

By integrating PLaMo 3 Translate into device applications, users can achieve high-quality, high-speed translations across 53 languages including English and Japanese, without needing an internet connection.

PFN's release of PLaMo 3 Translate aims to expand recognition of its generative AI foundation model PLaMo, while accelerating open innovation through edge-device LLMs. PFN expects this release to drive new use cases across the tourism, enterprise business, disaster response sectors and more.

Key Features of PLaMo 3 Translate

1. High-quality output on small models

According to PFN’s comparative evaluations, even the smallest 0.8B version of PLaMo 3 Translate outperforms comparable translation-specific LLMs, such as Google’s TranslateGemma and Tencent’s Hy-MT2. Users can generate highly accurate translations locally without requiring massive computing infrastructure.

2. Scalable across hardware ecosystems

The availability of four distinct model sizes ensures that users can optimize for speed, quality, and hardware capacity. The smaller models can run swiftly on smartphones, laptops, and wearable devices completely offline, delivering instant translations. Use cases scale from personal mobile devices to on-premises enterprise servers and embedded corporate services.

3. Uncompromised privacy for confidential data

Because the model runs locally on user-managed servers or devices, neither the original text nor the translated output is ever sent to external cloud servers. This makes PLaMo 3 Translate ideal for translating highly sensitive materials, such as contracts, R&D documentation, and customer support logs, while maintaining strict compliance with corporate data privacy and security policies.

4. Advanced glossary control and contextual formatting

Users can customize translation outputs by feeding the model surrounding context and providing specific glossaries for proper nouns, technical jargon, and product names. Additionally, when translating into Japanese, the model offers precise control over the tone of the output, allowing users to specify either formal honorific forms or plain language forms.

Model Availability and Commercial Licensing

All four PLaMo 3 Translate models are available today on the AI community hub Hugging Face under the PLaMo Community License. Interested organizations can test the translation speed and quality on their own devices before fully integrating it into their workflows.

For model downloads and detailed licensing terms, please visit the respective Hugging Face repositories:

  • plamo-3-translate-0.8b
  • plamo-3-translate-2b
  • plamo-3-translate-8b
  • plamo-3-translate-31b

Commercial use, including internal corporate operations and integration into commercial products or services, is permitted free of charge for organizations generating less than 1 billion Japanese yen (approx. $6.5M USD) annually. Organizations exceeding this revenue threshold require a commercial license agreement with PFN. For commercial licensing inquiries, please contact PFN via the inquiry form.

For a deep dive into the performance evaluations and the development history of the models, read the PFN Tech Blog post: PLaMo 3 Translate: World-Class Translation with Open Weights—Here’s How We Built It

*PLaMo 3 Translate is a specialized translation model developed by PFN baked on PLaMo 3 NICT, a pre-trained model developed through joint research between PFN and Japan's National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT).

translation.html:
更正（2026年11月5日 11:45）：根据 PLaMo 社区许可证，最近一个财年年收入低于 10 亿日元或以下的个人和企业可免费下载和使用这些模型。 

东京，2026年11月5日 ——Preferred Networks, Inc.（PFN）今日宣布，以开放权重形式发布 PLaMo™ 3 Translate*，这是一套专门用于翻译的大语言模型（LLM）。这些模型最初为 PFN 的 PLaMo Translate 服务开发，如今其开放权重版本已在 PFN 的 Hugging Face 页面上公开提供。

根据 PLaMo 社区许可证，最近一个财年年收入为 10 亿日元或以下的个人和企业可免费下载和使用这些模型。这同时适用于商业和非商业用途，用户无需连接互联网，即可完全在智能手机、笔记本电脑和企业内部服务器等边缘设备上运行模型。

PLaMo 3 Translate 为用户提供在自有硬件上原生运行 AI 所需的底层模型权重。它提供四种规模：0.8B（8 亿参数）、2B、8B 和 31B。这种分级方式使开发者能够根据自身对翻译质量、延迟、处理量和目标硬件的具体要求，选择最合适的模型。

通过将 PLaMo 3 Translate 集成到设备应用中，用户无需连接互联网，即可在包括英语和日语在内的 53 种语言之间实现高质量、高速度的翻译。

PFN 发布 PLaMo 3 Translate，旨在提升其生成式 AI 基础模型 PLaMo 的知名度，同时通过边缘设备上的大语言模型加速开放式创新。PFN 预计，此次发布将推动旅游、企业业务、灾害应对等领域出现新的应用场景。

PLaMo 3 Translate 的主要特点

1. 小模型也能提供高质量输出

根据 PFN 的对比评估，即使是最小的 0.8B 版 PLaMo 3 Translate，其表现也优于 Google 的 TranslateGemma 和腾讯的 Hy-MT2 等同类翻译专用大语言模型。用户无需庞大的计算基础设施，即可在本地生成高精度译文。

2. 可适配多种硬件生态

四种不同的模型规模确保用户能够根据速度、质量和硬件能力进行优化。较小的模型可在智能手机、笔记本电脑和可穿戴设备上完全离线地快速运行，提供即时翻译。应用场景可从个人移动设备扩展到企业本地部署的服务器和嵌入式企业服务。

3. 充分保护机密数据隐私

由于模型在用户管理的服务器或设备上本地运行，原文和译文都不会发送到外部云服务器。因此，PLaMo 3 Translate 非常适合翻译合同、研发文档和客户支持日志等高度敏感的材料，同时严格遵守企业的数据隐私和安全政策。

4. 高级术语表控制与上下文格式设置

用户可以向模型提供上下文，以及针对专有名词、技术术语和产品名称的特定术语表，以定制翻译输出。此外，在译为日语时，模型还支持精确控制输出的语体，用户可指定使用正式敬体或简体。

模型获取与商业许可

全部四款 PLaMo 3 Translate 模型今日均已依据 PLaMo 社区许可证在 AI 社区平台 Hugging Face 上提供。有兴趣的组织可以先在自有设备上测试翻译速度和质量，再将其全面集成到工作流程中。

如需下载模型及了解详细许可条款，请访问相应的 Hugging Face 仓库：

  • plamo-3-translate-0.8b
  • plamo-3-translate-2b
  • plamo-3-translate-8b
  • plamo-3-translate-31b

年收入低于 10 亿日元（约合 650 万美元）的组织可免费进行商业使用，包括企业内部运营以及集成到商业产品或服务中。收入超过此门槛的组织需要与 PFN 签订商业许可协议。如需咨询商业许可，请通过 咨询表单联系 PFN。

如需深入了解模型的性能评估和开发历程，请阅读 PFN 技术博客文章：PLaMo 3 Translate：以开放权重实现世界一流翻译——我们是如何构建它的

*PLaMo 3 Translate 是 PFN 基于 PLaMo 3 NICT 开发的翻译专用模型。PLaMo 3 NICT 是 PFN 与日本国立信息通信研究机构（NICT）通过联合研究开发的预训练模型。
